question: Which published comparisons and broad recipient representations qualify a useful A36 partial screen?
decision: Reuse published pathway results; qualify original combined bins and denominators for a bounded within-bin/representation comparison, while holding later survival and fine NSC identities.
strongest_rival: Wrong alias/dose mapping, conflating broad annotations with purified NSCs, and capture/pooling differences can misidentify the available comparison.
discriminator: Audit exact S3 comparison labels and annotation Methods; reconcile retained recovery tables and compare captured fractions with explicit all-cell and three-lineage-bin denominators. This does not estimate mouse treatment effects.
exposure_record: Paper, S6, S3 comparison labels and selected enrichment rows, all original recovery values and earlier RNA/animal findings were inspected before this freeze. No confirmation or unexposed source claim.
biological_unit: Source table row and one observed condition library/pool; individual mouse-to-cell mapping unavailable.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells nested in condition pools; old-control shared across contrasts. Reused source tables and metadata-review products are the same evidence lineage.
population_and_selection: All 96 alias-by-original-bin source rows retained for audit; descriptive contrasts use Young, Control, WT5 and Mut5 and unchanged original cell types. Three lineage-associated bins explicitly named in plan.
contrast: Mut5-WT5, Mut5-Control, WT5-Control, Young-Control reference; no other-dose expression or age interaction.
endpoint: Source comparison/annotation eligibility, captured counts and fractions, published S3 rows with exact locators.
methods: Read exact source workbooks with openpyxl, verify first ten S3 columns from raw ZIP/OOXML independently, reconcile prior recovery receipts, integer totals and Fraction arithmetic, render denominator-explicit representation figure. Do not rerun enrichment or biological models.
missingness_and_exclusions: No cell removal or relabeling; all source bins retained. Unsupported aliases excluded only from new contrasts, not erased. Source enrichment is not absence testing. Missing downstream measurements explicitly held.
multiplicity: Report every declared representation contrast; source P values are archived as published values, not new inference. No cell-resampled tests or selection by significance.
precision_basis: Finite observed source/pool descriptions. Exact integer and rational checks verify arithmetic; no population uncertainty is identifiable.
interpretation_limit: No tissue census, purified NSC identity, population effect, independent replication, fate, secretion, IFN type, survival, maturation, age modification or injury repair.
stop_rule: Stop on source hash, duplicate/join, total, OOXML or arithmetic mismatch. Preserve failed receipt; code/design correction requires new version. Do not change source values to agree.
amendment_reason: Initial exposed A36 source/representation execution after owner registration authorization.
